question: Under what condition may Śrīvidyā be revealed to others?
premises: Śrīvidyā is obtained through the guru's grace
Disclosure is prohibited at any time
inference: Even when obtained through the guru's grace, Śrīvidyā must never be revealed
uncertainties: Gender of labdho does not match feminine śrīvidyā; may reflect transmission or implied referent
plain_english: When obtained through the grace of the revered guru, it must never be revealed.
